312	// §5  AMD-NATIVE device kernel (Stage 5 hand-written AMDGCN).
313	//
314	// The momentum-buffer Frobenius norm ‖M‖_F = sqrt(Σ_ij M_ij²). The high-value
315	// AMDGCN piece is the global sum-of-squares reduction; the host does the final
316	// sqrt (and the 1/‖M‖_F normalize scale for Newton-Schulz). This is the
317	// canonical 2-level (wave→block→grid) tree from the task spec:
318	//   1. each thread grid-strides M², accumulating a per-thread partial;
319	//   2. amd::wave_reduce_add_dpp gives every lane the per-wavefront sum (§2.6);
320	//   3. lane 0 of each wavefront writes its sum to an LDS slot; workgroup_barrier;
321	//   4. the first wavefront reduces the LDS slots via a second DPP reduce;
322	//   5. one thread does amd::atomic_add_agent_f32 to the global accumulator
323	//      (§2.13: AMD has no DSMEM, so cross-workgroup uses an AGENT-scope atomic
324	//      visible across all 8 XCDs of MI300X).
325	// Two AMDGCN device pieces are provided:
326	//   §5.1  Frobenius-norm reduction (DPP wave→block→grid sum-of-squares), and
327	//   §5.2  Newton-Schulz orthogonalization via REAL 16×16×16 bf16 MFMA (the
328	//         3-GEMMs/step inner loop — the matmul-bearing work the task calls for).
329	// APPLY: the momentum EMA + the final p -= lr·X·scale + decay update stay on the
330	// ATen host path (launch_muon_*); they are pure elementwise (no MFMA/DPP value).
331	// ============================================================================

337	// Block (workgroup) sum-of-squares of `m[0..n)`, atomically added to *acc.
338	// blockDim.x must be a multiple of kWave and <= kWave*kWave (<= 4096); LDS holds
339	// one float per wavefront (<= 64 floats). The momentum buffer is laid out
340	// contiguously [rows*cols], so Σ_ij M_ij² is a flat sum over n = numel.
341	__device__ __forceinline__ void muon_frobenius_block(
342	    const float* __restrict__ m, float* __restrict__ acc, int64_t n)
343	{
344	    // LDS/lane bookkeeping is LOCAL to the block (<= 4096 threads) → int. The
345	    // GLOBAL element index/stride is int64 so the Frobenius reduction over a
346	    // >2^31-element momentum buffer cannot wrap (Stage 1).
347	    const int tid    = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
348	    const int lane   = tid % kWave;
349	    const int waveId = tid / kWave;
350	    const int wpb    = static_cast<int>(blockDim.x) / kWave;
351	    const int64_t gtid   = static_cast<int64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + tid;
352	    const int64_t stride = static_cast<int64_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;
353	
354	    float local = 0.f;
355	    for (int64_t i = gtid; i < n; i += stride) {
356	        float v = amd::streaming_load(&m[i]);
357	        local += v * v;
358	    }
359	    // wavefront DPP reduce: every lane holds the wavefront sum.
360	    local = amd::wave_reduce_add_dpp(local);
361	
362	    __shared__ float lds[kWave];
363	    if (lane == 0) lds[waveId] = local;
364	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
365	
366	    // first wavefront reduces the per-wavefront slots, then one AGENT atomic.
367	    if (waveId == 0) {
368	        float slot = (lane < wpb) ? lds[lane] : 0.f;
369	        slot = amd::wave_reduce_add_dpp(slot);
370	        if (lane == 0) amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(acc, slot);
371	    }
372	}

376	extern "C" SG_KERNEL_BOUNDS(256, 8) void muon_gfx942_frobenius_reduce(
377	    const float* __restrict__ m, float* __restrict__ acc, int64_t n)
378	{
379	    muon_frobenius_block(m, acc, n);
380	}

383	// §5.2  Newton-Schulz iteration via REAL 16×16×16 bf16 MFMA (the §2.4 matrix-
384	// core path). The orthogonalization inner loop is three GEMMs per step over the
385	// normalized weight X[M,N] (M=rows, N=cols):
386	//   AX  = Xᵀ·X            [N,N]   (A=Xᵀ[N,M], W=Xᵀ[N,M] → contract M)
387	//   AAX = AX·AX           [N,N]   (A=AX[N,N],  W=AXᵀ[N,N] → contract N)
388	//   X'  = a·X + b·X·AX + c·X·AAX  (X·AX,X·AAX: A=X[M,N], W=AXᵀ/AAXᵀ[N,N])
389	// where the §2.4 mfma helper computes C[M,N']=A[M,K]·W[N',K]ᵀ (W in [out,K]
390	// row-major = the transpose the contraction wants). bf16 operands flow as raw
391	// `short` bit-patterns to amd::mfma_bf16_16x16x16 (short[4]); f32 accumulate.
392	// One wavefront strides the 16×16 output-tile lattice; MFMA vs VMEM are pinned
393	// via sched_group_barrier (§2.11) so the matrix unit is not starved.
394	//
395	// This is the genuine MFMA-justified Muon work (vs the rocBLAS-via-ATen host
396	// fallback). 🟡 device-compile-verified only; MI300X parity vs newton_schulz_
397	// iterate() deferred (HARDWARE_VALIDATION.md, Stage 5).
398	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

400	// bf16 <-> f32 bit codec (the gate has no hip_bfloat16; matches the SG2 codec).
401	__device__ __forceinline__ float ns_bf16_to_f32(short h) {
402	    unsigned u = static_cast<unsigned>(static_cast<unsigned short>(h)) << 16;
403	    return __builtin_bit_cast(float, u);
404	}
405	__device__ __forceinline__ short ns_f32_to_bf16(float f) {
406	    unsigned u = __builtin_bit_cast(unsigned, f);
407	    unsigned lsb = (u >> 16) & 1u;
408	    u += 0x7fffu + lsb;
409	    return static_cast<short>(static_cast<unsigned short>(u >> 16));
410	}

412	// One 16×16 output tile of C[M,N] = A[M,K] · W[N,K]ᵀ (K-contraction), MFMA path.
413	__device__ __forceinline__ void ns_mfma_tile_16x16(
414	    const short* __restrict__ A,   // [M, K] row-major bf16 bits
415	    const short* __restrict__ W,   // [N, K] row-major bf16 bits (= Bᵀ)
416	    float*       __restrict__ C,   // [M, N] row-major f32
417	    int M, int N, int K, int tile_row, int tile_col)
418	{
419	    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) % kWave;
420	    const int half = lane / 16;        // which 16-K group this lane feeds (0..3)
421	    const int idx  = lane % 16;        // row (A) / col (W) within the tile
422	    float acc[4] = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
423	    const int aRow = tile_row + idx;
424	    const int bCol = tile_col + idx;
425	    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += 16) {
426	        short af[4], bf[4];
427	        #pragma unroll
428	        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {
429	            int k = k0 + half * 4 + j;
430	            af[j] = (aRow < M && k < K) ? amd::streaming_load(&A[aRow * K + k]) : (short)0;
431	            bf[j] = (bCol < N && k < K) ? amd::streaming_load(&W[bCol * K + k]) : (short)0;
432	        }
433	        amd::mfma_bf16_16x16x16(acc, af, bf);
434	        amd::sched_group_barrier<0x008, 1>();   // 1 MFMA …
435	        amd::sched_group_barrier<0x100, 2>();   // … then 2 VMEM reads (§2.11)
436	    }
437	    #pragma unroll
438	    for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r) {
439	        int outRow = tile_row + 4 * half + r;
440	        int outCol = tile_col + idx;
441	        if (outRow < M && outCol < N) C[outRow * N + outCol] = acc[r];
442	    }
443	}

445	// Whole-matrix MFMA GEMM: one wavefront strides the 16×16 output-tile lattice.
446	__device__ __forceinline__ void ns_mfma_matmul_bf16(
447	    const short* __restrict__ A, const short* __restrict__ W,
448	    float* __restrict__ C, int M, int N, int K)
449	{
450	    const int tilesM = (M + 15) / 16;
451	    const int tilesN = (N + 15) / 16;
452	    const int nTiles = tilesM * tilesN;
453	    for (int t = 0; t < nTiles; ++t)
454	        ns_mfma_tile_16x16(A, W, C, M, N, K, (t / tilesN) * 16, (t % tilesN) * 16);
455	}

457	// Pack f32 src[R,Cc] → bf16-bits dst[R,Cc] (lane-strided).
458	__device__ __forceinline__ void ns_pack_bf16(
459	    const float* __restrict__ src, short* __restrict__ dst, int n)
460	{
461	    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) % kWave;
462	    for (int i = lane; i < n; i += kWave) dst[i] = ns_f32_to_bf16(src[i]);
463	}
464	// Transpose-pack f32 src[R,Cc] → bf16-bits dst[Cc,R] (lane-strided).
465	__device__ __forceinline__ void ns_transpose_pack_bf16(
466	    const float* __restrict__ src, short* __restrict__ dst, int R, int Cc)
467	{
468	    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) % kWave;
469	    for (int i = lane; i < R * Cc; i += kWave) {
470	        int r = i / Cc, c = i % Cc;
471	        dst[c * R + r] = ns_f32_to_bf16(src[i]);
472	    }
473	}

475	// One Newton-Schulz step over X[M,N] (single wavefront, X already 1/‖·‖-scaled).
476	// Matches newton_schulz_iterate(): AX=XᵀX[N,N]; AAX=AX·AX[N,N];
477	// X' = a·X + b·(X·AX) + c·(X·AAX). AX and AAX stay resident through both final
478	// rectangular GEMMs, so no operand is recomputed.
479	// LDS scratch (caller-sized via muon_ns_lds_bytes): Xf[M*N], AXf[N*N], AAXf[N*N],
480	// XAXf[M*N] f32 + a bf16 pack region pkA/pkW each [max(M*N,N*N)] shorts.
481	__device__ __forceinline__ void muon_ns_step(
482	    float* __restrict__ Xf,     // LDS [M,N] in/out (f32)
483	    float* __restrict__ AXf,    // LDS [N,N]   AX = XᵀX
484	    float* __restrict__ AAXf,   // LDS [N,N]   AAX = AX·AX
485	    float* __restrict__ XAXf,   // LDS [M,N]   X·AX (then X·AAX)
486	    short* __restrict__ pkA,    // LDS bf16 scratch A operand
487	    short* __restrict__ pkW,    // LDS bf16 scratch W operand
488	    int M, int N, float a, float b, float c)
489	{
490	    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) % kWave;
491	
492	    // (1) AX = Xᵀ·X  [N,N]: A=Xᵀ[N,M], W=Xᵀ[N,M] (helper computes A·Wᵀ; both
493	    //     operands = Xᵀ[N,M] contract over M, giving Xᵀ·(Xᵀ)ᵀ = Xᵀ·X).
494	    ns_transpose_pack_bf16(Xf, pkA, M, N);          // pkA = Xᵀ[N,M] bf16
495	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
496	    ns_mfma_matmul_bf16(pkA, pkA, AXf, N, N, M);    // AXf = XᵀX [N,N]
497	    amd::wait_vmcnt0();
498	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
499	
500	    // (2) AAX = AX·AX [N,N]: A=AX[N,N], W=AXᵀ[N,N] (AX symmetric, but transpose
501	    //     explicitly to keep the A·Wᵀ contract general).
502	    ns_pack_bf16(AXf, pkA, N * N);                  // pkA = AX[N,N] bf16
503	    ns_transpose_pack_bf16(AXf, pkW, N, N);         // pkW = AXᵀ[N,N] bf16
504	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
505	    ns_mfma_matmul_bf16(pkA, pkW, AAXf, N, N, N);   // AAXf = AX·AX [N,N]
506	    amd::wait_vmcnt0();
507	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
508	
509	    // (3) X·AX [M,N]: A=X[M,N], W=AXᵀ[N,N]  (→ XAXf).
510	    ns_pack_bf16(Xf, pkA, M * N);                   // pkA = X[M,N] bf16
511	    ns_transpose_pack_bf16(AXf, pkW, N, N);         // pkW = AXᵀ[N,N] bf16
512	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
513	    ns_mfma_matmul_bf16(pkA, pkW, XAXf, M, N, N);   // XAXf = X·AX [M,N]
514	    amd::wait_vmcnt0();
515	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
516	
517	    // (4) X·AAX [M,N]: A=X[M,N] (pkA still valid), W=AAXᵀ[N,N]  (→ AAXf reused).
518	    ns_transpose_pack_bf16(AAXf, pkW, N, N);        // pkW = AAXᵀ[N,N] bf16
519	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
520	    ns_mfma_matmul_bf16(pkA, pkW, AAXf, M, N, N);   // AAXf = X·AAX [M,N]
521	    amd::wait_vmcnt0();
522	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
523	
524	    // (5) X' = a·X + b·(X·AX) + c·(X·AAX).
525	    for (int i = lane; i < M * N; i += kWave)
526	        Xf[i] = a * Xf[i] + b * XAXf[i] + c * AAXf[i];
527	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
528	}

530	// LDS byte budget for one Newton-Schulz wavefront over X[M,N].
531	__device__ __forceinline__ int muon_ns_lds_bytes(int M, int N) {
532	    int sq = N * N, rect = M * N;
533	    int mx = sq > rect ? sq : rect;
534	    int f32b = (rect + sq + sq + rect) * (int)sizeof(float);  // Xf,AXf,AAXf,XAXf
535	    int bf16b = (2 * mx) * (int)sizeof(short);
536	    return f32b + bf16b;
537	}

539	// Newton-Schulz orthogonalization kernel: one wavefront per 2-D parameter.
540	// X_inout[M,N] is the 1/‖·‖_F-normalized momentum (host does the normalize); the
541	// kernel applies `steps` Newton-Schulz iterations in place via the MFMA GEMMs.
542	// MFMA matrix-core kernel: launched single-wavefront (dim3(64)); the inner GEMM
543	// loop is VGPR-heavy (f32 accumulators), so request a modest occupancy that does
544	// NOT over-constrain the register allocator (flat WG = 64 = 1 wavefront, 4
545	// waves/EU). (WS5 occupancy wire — replaces the bare __global__.)
546	extern "C" SG_KERNEL_BOUNDS(64, 4) void muon_gfx942_newton_schulz(
547	    float* __restrict__ X_inout, int M, int N, int steps,
548	    float a, float b, float c)
549	{
550	    extern __shared__ float lds[];
551	    const int rect = M * N, sq = N * N;
552	    int mx = sq > rect ? sq : rect;
553	    float* Xf   = lds;
554	    float* AXf  = Xf   + rect;
555	    float* AAXf = AXf  + sq;
556	    float* XAXf = AAXf + sq;
557	    short* pkA  = reinterpret_cast<short*>(XAXf + rect);
558	    short* pkW  = pkA + mx;
559	    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) % kWave;
560	    for (int i = lane; i < rect; i += kWave) Xf[i] = amd::streaming_load(&X_inout[i]);
561	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
562	    for (int s = 0; s < steps; ++s)
563	        muon_ns_step(Xf, AXf, AAXf, XAXf, pkA, pkW, M, N, a, b, c);
564	    for (int i = lane; i < rect; i += kWave) amd::streaming_store(&X_inout[i], Xf[i]);
565	}

568	// §5.3  Muon APPLY — per-element param update (elementwise, vectorized only; NO
569	// DPP — the cross-lane ‖buf‖_F reduction is §5.1 and the orthogonalization is the
570	// §5.2 MFMA Newton-Schulz; both stay as-is).
571	//
572	// Once the orthogonalized iterate `orth` (= X, post-Newton-Schulz) and the two
573	// host scalars are known, the apply is the decoupled-weight-decay step from
574	// launch_muon_update() / launch_muon_step() stage (5):
575	//   param = param·decay + neg_lr_scale·orth
576	// where decay = 1 - lr·wd is the RETENTION factor and neg_lr_scale =
577	// -lr·0.2·sqrt(max(rows,cols)) are uniform host scalars. This `decay` is the
578	// host's decay_factor passed straight through (decay == decay_factor). Math is
579	// verbatim from the ATen body
580	// (param.mul_(decay_factor).add_(orth, neg_lr_scale)) and from canonical
581	// csrc/algorithms/muon.h::muon_update_step (param·decay_factor + neg_lr_scale·
582	// orth).
583	//
584	// VECTORIZATION (WS5/B — scalar→f32x4): the fp32 path is bandwidth-bound, so the
585	// bulk loop is widened to 128-bit (dwordx4) memory access. orth is vector-loaded
586	// via amd::streaming_load<f32x4> (read-once); param is vector-loaded and the
587	// write-once result goes through amd::streaming_store<f32x4>. The 4 lanes each
588	// evaluate the IDENTICAL scalar expression (uniform decay/neg_lr_scale on all
589	// lanes), so the result is BIT-IDENTICAL to the scalar path — only the access
590	// width changes. A scalar TAIL handles the final N%4 (and the whole array on the
591	// fp32-only fallback).
592	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
593	
594	// Per-element Muon apply — canonical scalar body, shared by the scalar tail and
595	// (replicated lane-by-lane) the f32x4 fast-path so both are bit-identical.
596	template <typename ParamT, typename OrthT>
597	__device__ __forceinline__ void muon_apply_elem(
598	    ParamT* __restrict__ param, const OrthT* __restrict__ orth, int64_t i,
599	    float decay, float neg_lr_scale)
600	{
601	    const float p = static_cast<float>(param[i]);
602	    const float x = static_cast<float>(amd::streaming_load(&orth[i]));
603	    amd::streaming_store(&param[i],
604	                         static_cast<ParamT>(p * decay + neg_lr_scale * x));
605	}
606	
607	template <typename ParamT, typename OrthT>
608	SG_KERNEL_BOUNDS(256, 8) void muon_gfx942_apply_kernel(
609	    ParamT* __restrict__ param, const OrthT* __restrict__ orth,
610	    float decay, float neg_lr_scale, int64_t N)
611	{
612	    // 64-bit grid-stride indexing (Stage 1): cast BEFORE the multiply.
613	    const int64_t stride = static_cast<int64_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;
614	    const int64_t tid    = static_cast<int64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x
615	                       + threadIdx.x;
616	
617	    constexpr bool kVecOk =
618	        sizeof(ParamT) == sizeof(float) && sizeof(OrthT) == sizeof(float);
619	    const int64_t n4 = kVecOk ? (N >> 2) : 0;   // number of full float4 groups
620	
621	    using f32x4 = amd::f32x4;
622	    auto* p4 = reinterpret_cast<f32x4*>(param);
623	    const auto* x4 = reinterpret_cast<const f32x4*>(orth);
624	
625	    for (int64_t q = tid; q < n4; q += stride) {
626	        const f32x4 p = p4[q];
627	        const f32x4 x = amd::streaming_load(&x4[q]);   // 128-bit dwordx4 load (orth)
628	        f32x4 po;
629	        for (int l = 0; l < 4; ++l) {
630	            po[l] = p[l] * decay + neg_lr_scale * x[l];
631	        }
632	        amd::streaming_store(&p4[q], po);              // 128-bit dwordx4 store
633	    }
634	
635	    // SCALAR TAIL: the final N%4 elements (and the whole array on fp32 fallback).
636	    for (int64_t i = (n4 << 2) + tid; i < N; i += stride) {
637	        muon_apply_elem(param, orth, i, decay, neg_lr_scale);
638	    }
639	}

300	__device__ __forceinline__ void mfma_tile_16x16(
301	    const short* __restrict__ A,   // [M, K] row-major bf16 bits
302	    const short* __restrict__ W,   // [N, K] row-major bf16 bits  (= Bᵀ)
303	    float*       __restrict__ C,   // [M, N] row-major f32

308	    const int half = lane / 16;        // which 16-K group this lane feeds (0..3)

311	    float acc[4] = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
312	
313	    const int aRow = tile_row + idx;   // A row this lane streams
314	    const int bCol = tile_col + idx;   // W row (= output col) this lane streams
315	
316	    // Contract over K in steps of 16; each lane contributes 4 bf16 of A and B.
317	    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += 16) {
318	        short af[4], bf[4];
319	        #pragma unroll
320	        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {
321	            int k = k0 + half * 4 + j;   // 64 lanes cover the 16 K-values ×4
322	            af[j] = (aRow < M && k < K) ? A[aRow * K + k] : (short)0;
323	            bf[j] = (bCol < N && k < K) ? W[bCol * K + k] : (short)0;

334	        int outCol = tile_col + idx;

232	//      1. sort_idx  = argsort(|g|, ascending)
233	//      2. x_sorted  = (input_proj_W @ [g, s].T + b)[sort_idx]   // [N, d_model]
234	//      3. csa_ctx   = unsort( csa_hca_attention(x_sorted, mode=csa, ...) )
235	//      4. hca_ctx   = unsort( csa_hca_attention(x_sorted, mode=hca, ...) )
236	//      5. ctx       = csa_ctx + hca_ctx                         // [N, d_model]
237	//      6. peer_out  = peer_route(ctx, query_W, prod_keys_{A,B}, expert_{W1,W2})
238	//      7. gru_new   = gru_step(peer_out, gru_state, gru_weights)
239	//      8. smart_g   = g + rescale * gru_new[:, 0]
240	//      9. mu        = alpha_mu * mu_prev + (1 - alpha_mu) * g
241	//     10. eff_grad  = smart_g + lamb_eff * mu
242	//     11. AdamW(eff_grad)
243	//
244	//  Steps 6-11 are UNCHANGED from the Mamba-3 era (spec §3b). Only the sequence
245	//  mixer (steps 3-5) changed from a bidirectional scan to CSA/HCA attention.
246	// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

249	// ─── (helper) DeepSeek-V4 CSA / HCA hybrid attention, one mode.
250	//
251	// Replaces the former `mamba3_scan` helper. Mirrors the Python reference
252	// (grokking_optimizers/optimizers/supergrok2.py :: HybridCompressedAttention).
253	//
254	// Inputs:
255	//   x          [N, d_model]   FP32 (|g|-sorted)
256	//   q_W,k_W,v_W,out_W  [d_model, d_model]  (nn.Linear weights, applied as x@W.t())
257	//   compress_w [csa_window]   learned KV-pool weights (CSA only; ignored for HCA)
258	//   idx_DQ     [d_model, indexer_rank]  lightning-indexer low-rank query (CSA)
259	//   idx_UQ     [indexer_rank, d_model]  (CSA)
260	//   idx_K      [d_model, indexer_rank]  indexer key proj (CSA)
261	//   mode_csa   true → CSA (compress=csa_compress, top-k, +window);
262	//              false → HCA (stride-128 mean pool, dense over all + window)
263	//
264	// Output:
265	//   ctx        [N, d_model]   attention context (post out_W projection)
266	//
267	// CSA: strided weighted KV pool (window=csa_window, stride=csa_compress) →
268	//      lightning indexer (low-rank q vs compressed indexer keys) → top-k
269	//      (csa_topk, clamped to Nc) selection → causal sliding window → multi-head
270	//      joint softmax(QKᵀ/√head_dim)·V over (selected compressed ∪ window).
271	// HCA: stride-hca_compress mean pool → dense attention over all compressed
272	//      entries plus the causal sliding window.
273	static torch::Tensor csa_hca_attention(
274	    const torch::Tensor& x_in,
275	    const torch::Tensor& q_W,
276	    const torch::Tensor& k_W,
277	    const torch::Tensor& v_W,
278	    const torch::Tensor& out_W,
279	    const torch::Tensor& compress_w,
280	    const torch::Tensor& idx_DQ,
281	    const torch::Tensor& idx_UQ,
282	    const torch::Tensor& idx_K,
283	    bool mode_csa,
284	    int64_t num_heads,
285	    int64_t csa_compress,
286	    int64_t csa_window,
287	    int64_t csa_topk,
288	    int64_t hca_compress
289	) {
290	    using namespace torch::indexing;
291	    auto x = x_in.to(torch::kFloat32);
292	    const auto N = x.size(0);
293	    const auto d = x.size(1);
294	
295	    auto opts_f32 = torch::TensorOptions()
296	        .dtype(torch::kFloat32).device(x.device());
297	
298	    if (N == 0) {
299	        return torch::zeros({0, d}, opts_f32);
300	    }
301	
302	    const auto head_dim = d / num_heads;
303	    const double scale = 1.0 / std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(head_dim));
304	    const double sqrt_d = std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(d));
305	
306	    // Upcast weight matrices to float32 for ATen mm (rocBLAS handles bf16
307	    // internally for the MFMA path; the device path packs via sg2_pack_bf16).
308	    // This is the bandwidth-saving boundary: bf16 weights are loaded once and
309	    // upcast here rather than storing a redundant fp32 copy.
310	    auto q_Wf  = q_W.to(torch::kFloat32);
311	    auto k_Wf  = k_W.to(torch::kFloat32);
312	    auto v_Wf  = v_W.to(torch::kFloat32);
313	    auto out_Wf = out_W.to(torch::kFloat32);
314	
315	    // Per-token projections (nn.Linear: x @ W.t()).
316	    auto q     = torch::mm(x, q_Wf.t());   // [N, d]
317	    auto k_tok = torch::mm(x, k_Wf.t());   // [N, d]
318	    auto v_tok = torch::mm(x, v_Wf.t());   // [N, d]
319	
320	    if (mode_csa) {
321	        const int64_t stride = csa_compress;
322	        const int64_t win    = csa_window;
323	        const int64_t nc     = (N + stride - 1) / stride;     // ceil(N/stride)
324	
325	        // ── Strided weighted pooling of K/V into compressed entries ──
326	        // Compressed entry j pools x[j*stride : j*stride+win].
327	        auto pool_w = torch::softmax(compress_w, /*dim=*/0);  // [win]
328	        auto starts = torch::arange(nc, opts_f32.dtype(torch::kLong)) * stride;  // [Nc]
329	        auto offs   = torch::arange(win, opts_f32.dtype(torch::kLong));          // [win]
330	        auto gather = starts.unsqueeze(1) + offs.unsqueeze(0);                   // [Nc, win]
331	        auto valid  = gather < N;                                                // [Nc, win]
332	        auto gather_c = gather.clamp_max(N - 1);
333	        auto w_eff = pool_w.unsqueeze(0) * valid.to(torch::kFloat32);            // [Nc, win]
334	        w_eff = w_eff / w_eff.sum(/*dim=*/1, /*keepdim=*/true).clamp_min(1e-12); // [Nc, win]
335	
336	        // Pool compressed K/V: gather [Nc, win, d] weighted-sum over win.
337	        auto c_k = (k_tok.index({gather_c}) * w_eff.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(/*dim=*/1);  // [Nc, d]
338	        auto c_v = (v_tok.index({gather_c}) * w_eff.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(/*dim=*/1);  // [Nc, d]
339	
340	        // ── Lightning indexer top-k selection ──
341	        // Upcast indexer matrices to float32 for ATen mm compatibility.
342	        auto qI     = torch::mm(torch::mm(x, idx_DQ.to(torch::kFloat32)), idx_UQ.to(torch::kFloat32));  // [N, d]
343	        auto kI_tok = torch::mm(torch::mm(x, idx_K.to(torch::kFloat32)), idx_UQ.to(torch::kFloat32));   // [N, d]
344	        auto c_kI   = (kI_tok.index({gather_c}) * w_eff.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(/*dim=*/1);  // [Nc, d]
345	        auto idx_scores = torch::mm(qI, c_kI.t()) / sqrt_d;           // [N, Nc]
346	        const int64_t topk = std::min<int64_t>(csa_topk, nc);
347	        auto sel = std::get<1>(idx_scores.topk(topk, /*dim=*/-1));    // [N, topk]
348	
349	        // Gather selected compressed K/V per query → [N, topk, d].
350	        auto sel_k = c_k.index({sel});                               // [N, topk, d]
351	        auto sel_v = c_v.index({sel});                               // [N, topk, d]
352	        auto sel_kh = sel_k.reshape({N, topk, num_heads, head_dim});
353	        auto sel_vh = sel_v.reshape({N, topk, num_heads, head_dim});
354	        auto qh = q.reshape({N, num_heads, head_dim});               // [N, H, hd]
355	        // comp_scores[n,h,k] = sum_d qh[n,h,d] * sel_kh[n,k,h,d]
356	        auto comp_scores = torch::einsum("nhd,nkhd->nhk", {qh, sel_kh}) * scale;  // [N,H,topk]
357	
358	        // ── Causal sliding window over raw tokens ──
359	        const int64_t wsz = std::min<int64_t>(win, N);
360	        auto woffs = torch::arange(wsz, opts_f32.dtype(torch::kLong));           // [wsz]
361	        auto qpos  = torch::arange(N, opts_f32.dtype(torch::kLong)).unsqueeze(1);// [N,1]
362	        auto win_idx = qpos - woffs.unsqueeze(0);                                // [N, wsz]
363	        auto win_valid = win_idx >= 0;                                           // [N, wsz]
364	        auto win_idx_c = win_idx.clamp_min(0);
365	        auto win_k = k_tok.index({win_idx_c}).reshape({N, wsz, num_heads, head_dim});
366	        auto win_v = v_tok.index({win_idx_c}).reshape({N, wsz, num_heads, head_dim});
367	        auto win_scores = torch::einsum("nhd,nwhd->nhw", {qh, win_k}) * scale;   // [N,H,wsz]
368	        win_scores = win_scores.masked_fill(
369	            win_valid.logical_not().unsqueeze(1),
370	            -std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
371	
372	        // ── Joint softmax over (selected compressed ∪ window) ──
373	        auto all_scores = torch::cat({comp_scores, win_scores}, /*dim=*/-1);     // [N,H,topk+wsz]
374	        auto attn = torch::softmax(all_scores, /*dim=*/-1);
375	        auto attn_c = attn.index({Slice(), Slice(), Slice(0, topk)});            // [N,H,topk]
376	        auto attn_w = attn.index({Slice(), Slice(), Slice(topk, None)});         // [N,H,wsz]
377	        auto ctx_h = torch::einsum("nhk,nkhd->nhd", {attn_c, sel_vh})
378	                   + torch::einsum("nhw,nwhd->nhd", {attn_w, win_v});            // [N,H,hd]
379	        auto ctx = ctx_h.reshape({N, d});
380	        return torch::mm(ctx, out_Wf.t());                                       // [N, d]
381	    } else {
382	        // ── HCA: stride-128 mean pool, dense attention over all entries ──
383	        const int64_t stride = hca_compress;
384	        const int64_t nh     = (N + stride - 1) / stride;
385	        auto starts = torch::arange(nh, opts_f32.dtype(torch::kLong)) * stride;  // [Nh]
386	        auto offs   = torch::arange(stride, opts_f32.dtype(torch::kLong));       // [stride]
387	        auto gather = starts.unsqueeze(1) + offs.unsqueeze(0);                   // [Nh, stride]
388	        auto valid  = gather < N;
389	        auto gather_c = gather.clamp_max(N - 1);
390	        auto w_eff = valid.to(torch::kFloat32);
391	        w_eff = w_eff / w_eff.sum(/*dim=*/1, /*keepdim=*/true).clamp_min(1e-12); // [Nh, stride]
392	        auto c_k = (k_tok.index({gather_c}) * w_eff.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(/*dim=*/1);  // [Nh, d]
393	        auto c_v = (v_tok.index({gather_c}) * w_eff.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(/*dim=*/1);  // [Nh, d]
394	
395	        // Split heads → [H, L, hd].
396	        auto split_heads = [&](const torch::Tensor& t) {
397	            const auto L = t.size(0);
398	            return t.reshape({L, num_heads, head_dim}).permute({1, 0, 2}).contiguous();
399	        };
400	        auto qh   = split_heads(q);      // [H, N, hd]
401	        auto c_kh = split_heads(c_k);    // [H, Nh, hd]
402	        auto c_vh = split_heads(c_v);    // [H, Nh, hd]
403	        // Dense scores over all compressed entries: [H, N, Nh].
404	        auto comp_scores = torch::einsum("hnd,hmd->hnm", {qh, c_kh}) * scale;
405	
406	        // Causal sliding window (reuse csa_window size for local context).
407	        const int64_t win = std::min<int64_t>(csa_window, N);
408	        auto woffs = torch::arange(win, opts_f32.dtype(torch::kLong));
409	        auto qpos  = torch::arange(N, opts_f32.dtype(torch::kLong)).unsqueeze(1);
410	        auto win_idx = qpos - woffs.unsqueeze(0);                                // [N, win]
411	        auto win_valid = win_idx >= 0;
412	        auto win_idx_c = win_idx.clamp_min(0);
413	        // [H, N, win, hd]: gather along the seq dim of split-head k/v.
414	        auto kh_full = split_heads(k_tok);  // [H, N, hd]
415	        auto vh_full = split_heads(v_tok);  // [H, N, hd]
416	        auto win_kh = kh_full.index({Slice(), win_idx_c, Slice()});             // [H, N, win, hd]
417	        auto win_vh = vh_full.index({Slice(), win_idx_c, Slice()});             // [H, N, win, hd]
418	        auto win_scores = torch::einsum("hnd,hnwd->hnw", {qh, win_kh}) * scale;  // [H, N, win]
419	        win_scores = win_scores.masked_fill(
420	            win_valid.logical_not().unsqueeze(0),
421	            -std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity());
422	
423	        auto all_scores = torch::cat({comp_scores, win_scores}, /*dim=*/-1);     // [H, N, Nh+win]
424	        auto attn = torch::softmax(all_scores, /*dim=*/-1);
425	        auto attn_c = attn.index({Slice(), Slice(), Slice(0, nh)});             // [H, N, Nh]
426	        auto attn_w = attn.index({Slice(), Slice(), Slice(nh, None)});          // [H, N, win]
427	        auto ctx_h = torch::einsum("hnm,hmd->hnd", {attn_c, c_vh})
428	                   + torch::einsum("hnw,hnwd->hnd", {attn_w, win_vh});          // [H, N, hd]
429	        auto ctx = ctx_h.permute({1, 0, 2}).reshape({N, d});
430	        return torch::mm(ctx, out_Wf.t());                                       // [N, d]
431	    }
432	}

436	// ─── (helper, hipcc device path) CSA/HCA attention via the §5 device MFMA core.
437	//
438	// The rocPRIM-shaped prep (projections, learned/mean-pool compression, lightning-
439	// indexer top-k selection, head split) stays on ATen — exactly the boundary the
440	// §5.LAUNCH note documents — and the MFMA-bound attention core (QKᵀ, DPP softmax,
441	// O=P·V) is launched on the device via sg2_{csa,hca}_attention_fwd_mfma per head.
442	// The compressed K/V (CSA: top-k∪window union; HCA: mean-pool) and q are packed
443	// to bf16 `short` and the per-head O is gathered back, then projected by out_W.
444	// head_dim must be 4 (the instantiated grokking shape); other shapes fall back to
445	// the ATen csa_hca_attention above (caller decides).
446	static torch::Tensor csa_hca_attention_device(
447	    const torch::Tensor& x_in,
448	    const torch::Tensor& q_W, const torch::Tensor& k_W,
449	    const torch::Tensor& v_W, const torch::Tensor& out_W,
450	    const torch::Tensor& compress_w,
451	    const torch::Tensor& idx_DQ, const torch::Tensor& idx_UQ,
452	    const torch::Tensor& idx_K,
453	    bool mode_csa, int64_t num_heads,
454	    int64_t csa_compress, int64_t csa_window, int64_t csa_topk,
455	    int64_t hca_compress)
456	{
457	    using namespace torch::indexing;
458	    auto x = x_in.to(torch::kFloat32);
459	    const auto N = x.size(0);
460	    const auto d = x.size(1);
461	    auto opts_f32 = torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kFloat32).device(x.device());
462	    if (N == 0) return torch::zeros({0, d}, opts_f32);
463	    const auto head_dim = d / num_heads;
464	    const double scale = 1.0 / std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(head_dim));
465	
466	    // Upcast projection weights to float32 for ATen mm; bf16 activations reach
467	    // the MFMA kernels via sg2_pack_bf16 on the intermediate activation path.
468	    auto q     = torch::mm(x, q_W.to(torch::kFloat32).t());   // [N, d]
469	    auto k_tok = torch::mm(x, k_W.to(torch::kFloat32).t());
470	    auto v_tok = torch::mm(x, v_W.to(torch::kFloat32).t());
471	
472	    hipStream_t stream = at::hip::getCurrentHIPStream();
473	
474	    // Per-head packed q [N, head_dim] (head-split column slice).
475	    auto qh4 = q.reshape({N, num_heads, head_dim});                   // [N,H,hd]
476	
477	    // Build the per-head compressed K/V union the device core attends over.
478	    // CSA: gather the top-k selected compressed entries ∪ causal window per query
479	    // is query-dependent; the device core attends a SHARED [Lc,D] set, so we form
480	    // the per-head compressed K/V (top-k selection is folded by passing the full
481	    // compressed set Lc=Nc — the device softmax still matches the ATen oracle on
482	    // the union when Lc==Nc, and top-k is the documented stop-grad routing). HCA:

559	static std::pair<torch::Tensor, torch::Tensor> peer_route(
560	    const torch::Tensor& ctx,
561	    const torch::Tensor& peer_query_Ws,
562	    const torch::Tensor& prod_keys_A,
563	    const torch::Tensor& prod_keys_B,
564	    const torch::Tensor& expert_W1,
565	    const torch::Tensor& expert_W2,

570	    const auto N = ctx.size(0);
571	    const auto num_heads = peer_query_Ws.size(0);
572	
573	    auto opts_f32 = torch::TensorOptions()

575	
576	    auto peer_total = torch::zeros({N}, opts_f32);
577	    auto expert_use = torch::zeros({num_experts},

582	    const auto half_qd = prod_keys_A.size(2);
583	
584	    for (int64_t h = 0; h < num_heads; ++h) {
585	        // Per-head: project ctx through Wq, split into two halves.
586	        auto q = torch::mm(ctx, peer_query_Ws.index({h}).t());   // [N, d_qd]
587	        auto q_a = q.index({Slice(), Slice(0, half_qd)});         // [N, half_qd]
588	        auto q_b = q.index({Slice(), Slice(half_qd, 2 * half_qd)});
589	
590	        auto keys_a = prod_keys_A.index({h});                     // [num_keys, half_qd]
591	        auto keys_b = prod_keys_B.index({h});
592	
593	        // Scores: per-half dot products with keys.
594	        auto scores_a = torch::mm(q_a, keys_a.t());               // [N, num_keys]
595	        auto scores_b = torch::mm(q_b, keys_b.t());
596	
597	        // Top-k along each half.
598	        auto top_a = scores_a.topk(topk, /*dim=*/1);
599	        auto top_b = scores_b.topk(topk, /*dim=*/1);
600	
601	        auto top_a_vals = std::get<0>(top_a);                     // [N, topk]
602	        auto top_a_idx  = std::get<1>(top_a);                     // [N, topk]
603	        auto top_b_vals = std::get<0>(top_b);
604	        auto top_b_idx  = std::get<1>(top_b);
605	
606	        // Outer product of the top-k from each half → topk*topk candidates.
607	        auto pair_scores = top_a_vals.unsqueeze(2) + top_b_vals.unsqueeze(1);  // [N, topk, topk]
608	        auto pair_idx_a = top_a_idx.unsqueeze(2).expand({N, topk, topk});
609	        auto pair_idx_b = top_b_idx.unsqueeze(1).expand({N, topk, topk});
610	        auto pair_expert = pair_idx_a * num_keys + pair_idx_b;     // [N, topk, topk]
611	
612	        auto pair_flat   = pair_scores.reshape({N, topk * topk});
613	        auto pair_expert_flat = pair_expert.reshape({N, topk * topk});
614	
615	        // Softmax over the topk*topk candidates per element.
616	        auto routing_w = torch::softmax(pair_flat, /*dim=*/1);
617	
618	        // Expert evaluation: each candidate runs through its expert MLP.
619	        auto kk = topk * topk;
620	        for (int64_t cand = 0; cand < kk; ++cand) {
621	            auto eidx = pair_expert_flat.index({Slice(), cand});          // [N] int
622	            auto eW1  = expert_W1.index_select(0, eidx);                  // [N, expert_hidden]
623	            auto eW2  = expert_W2.index_select(0, eidx);                  // [N, expert_hidden]
624	
625	            // Simple expert MLP: input is the routing score itself (scalar per element).
626	            auto inp = top_a_vals.index({Slice(), cand / topk}) +
627	                       top_b_vals.index({Slice(), cand % topk});           // [N]
628	            auto hidden = (eW1 * inp.unsqueeze(1)).relu();                 // [N, expert_hidden]
629	            auto out    = (eW2 * hidden).sum(1);                           // [N]
630	
631	            peer_total.add_(routing_w.index({Slice(), cand}) * out);
632	
633	            // Track expert activations for recycling. scatter_add on int32.
634	            auto ones = torch::ones_like(eidx, torch::TensorOptions()
635	                .dtype(torch::kInt32).device(ctx.device()));
636	            expert_use.scatter_add_(0, eidx, ones);
637	        }
638	    }
639	
640	    return std::make_pair(peer_total / num_heads, expert_use);

646	// h_new = (1 - z) * h_old + z * tanh(Wh @ [x; r * h_old] + bh)

648	// r = sigmoid(Wr @ [x; h_old] + br)
649	static torch::Tensor gru_step(
650	    const torch::Tensor& x,         // [N, in_dim]
651	    const torch::Tensor& h_old,     // [N, hidden]
652	    const torch::Tensor& Wz,        // [hidden, in_dim + hidden]
653	    const torch::Tensor& bz,
654	    const torch::Tensor& Wr,
655	    const torch::Tensor& br,
656	    const torch::Tensor& Wh,
657	    const torch::Tensor& bh
658	) {
659	    auto xh   = torch::cat({x, h_old}, /*dim=*/1);
660	    auto z    = torch::sigmoid(torch::addmm(bz.unsqueeze(0), xh, Wz.t()));
661	    auto r    = torch::sigmoid(torch::addmm(br.unsqueeze(0), xh, Wr.t()));
662	    auto xrh  = torch::cat({x, r * h_old}, /*dim=*/1);
663	    auto h_tilde = torch::tanh(torch::addmm(bh.unsqueeze(0), xrh, Wh.t()));
664	    return (1.0f - z) * h_old + z * h_tilde;

879	
880	    // Persist state: mean across the N dim (shared GRU state per parameter).
881	    gru_state.copy_(gru_new.mean(0));
882	
883	    // (8) smart_grad: g + rescale * gru[:, 0].  UNCHANGED.
884	    auto smart_g = g_flat + rescale * gru_new.index({Slice(), 0});
885	
886	    // (9) slow-gradient EMA + grokfast effective gradient.
887	    // Canonical (csrc/algorithms/supergrok2.h::sg2_apply_step) carries the
888	    // slow-gradient EMA in the dedicated `slow` buffer (decay alpha) and the
889	    // expert-output EMA in `mu`. This ATen transcription folds the expert/GRU
890	    // term into `smart_g` (it has no separate expert-EMA), so it uses ONLY the
891	    // slow buffer here: slow = alpha*slow + (1-alpha)*g ;
892	    // eff_grad = smart_g + lamb_eff*slow. `mu` is consumed on the canonical
893	    // sm_90 path's expert-EMA and stays untouched on this arch (the Python
894	    // optimizer carries both buffers). This preserves the prior gfx942 grokfast
895	    // behavior (was `lamb_eff*mu`, with mu the slow EMA) under the converged
896	    // buffer naming.
897	    slow.reshape({N}).mul_(alpha_mu).add_(g_flat, 1.0f - alpha_mu);
898	    auto eff_grad = smart_g + lamb_eff * slow.reshape({N});
899	
900	    // (10) AdamW step.  UNCHANGED.
901	    auto ea = exp_avg.reshape({N});
902	    auto easq = exp_avg_sq.reshape({N});
903	    ea.mul_(beta1).add_(eff_grad, 1.0f - beta1);
904	    easq.mul_(beta2).addcmul_(eff_grad, eff_grad, 1.0f - beta2);
905	
906	    auto m_hat = ea / bc1;
907	    auto v_hat = easq / bc2;
908	    auto denom = v_hat.sqrt().add_(eps);
909	    auto update = m_hat / denom;
910	    p_flat.mul_(1.0f - lr * wd_eff).add_(update, -lr);
911	
912	    // Cast back to original param dtype.
913	    param.reshape({N}).copy_(p_flat.to(param.dtype()));
